tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get your own workload.zero profile (name, job title, bio, location, skills).

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.description: Update your own profile. Pass the fields to change as a JSON object string.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List the users of the workspace (id and name). Use the id for direct messages; for task assignment use list_team_members or the user id.

tools.name: get_my_colleagues
tools.description: List the people you share projects with, incl. their team member ids.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: List team members (id | user | type | weekly capacity). The team member id is what projects and task assignments store.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across projects, tasks (title, number, linked issue) and users. Example: query "ZERO-41" or "login bug".

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: List your notifications, newest first (id | read | title | message).

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark one notification as read, or all of them when notificationId is left out.

tools.name: get_activity_feed
tools.description: Recent changes in your projects (who changed what), optionally for one project or one area.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the projects you have access to (id | code | name | status | client).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a project: status, client, budget, period, team member ids, task count and description.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project. clientId comes from list_clients (or create_client). Example: title "Website relaunch", projectCode "WEB", duration {startDate: "2026-11-01", endDate: "2027-03-31"}, budget {hourlyRate: 95, currency: "EUR"}.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update a project. Give only the fields to change, e.g. status "on_hold" or a new end date in duration. The legacy `updates` JSON string is still accepted.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project you created. It is archived and hidden from all members; tasks and time entries stay in the database.

tools.name: get_project_budget
tools.description: Budget analytics of a project: planned vs. used hours and amount, burn rate.

tools.name: list_project_members
tools.description: List the members of a project (team member id | user id | name | role | weekly hours). Use the team member id for add/update/remove_project_member.

tools.name: add_project_member
tools.description: Add a team member to a project (admin or project manager). teamMemberId comes from list_team_members.

tools.name: update_project_member
tools.description: Change role, weekly hours, capacity or permissions of a project member.

tools.name: remove_project_member
tools.description: Remove a team member from a project. Their tasks stay assigned until you reassign them.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List project clients (id | name | company | email). Use the id as clientId in create_project.

tools.name: create_client
tools.description: Create a project client (admin or project manager).

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (id | number | title | status | priority | project | assignees | due). Without projectId: your assigned tasks, or with view "all" every task in your projects. With projectId: all tasks of that project, filterable by assignee and priority.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get one task with description, status, priority, assignees, estimate and booked hours, start/due date, tags, linked issue, links, subtask parent, attachments (with download links) and comments.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task (shown in workload.zero as created by an agent). Example: projectId from list_projects, title "Fix login redirect", priority "high", assignedTo [user or team member id], deadline {startDateTime: "2026-11-10T09:00:00Z", endDateTime: "2026-11-14T17:00:00Z"}, maxHours 6.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a task. Give only the fields to change: status, title, description, priority, assignedTo (replaces the list), tags (replaces), deadline, maxHours, linkedIssue, links (replaces), parentTaskId. Archive with status "archived". The legacy `updates` JSON string is still accepted.

tools.name: assign_task_to_me
tools.description: Add yourself to the assignees of a task.

tools.name: unassign_me_from_task
tools.description: Remove yourself from the assignees of a task.

tools.name: list_subtasks
tools.description: List the subtasks of a task. Create a subtask with create_task and parentTaskId.

tools.name: move_task_on_board
tools.description: Move a task to a board column (status) and position (0 = top).

tools.name: add_task_link
tools.description: Add a link to a task, e.g. the pull request, Figma frame or Jira ticket.

tools.name: remove_task_link
tools.description: Remove a link from a task by its position in the links list (0-based, as shown by get_task).

tools.name: set_task_work_links
tools.description: Replace the work result links of a task (what the assignee delivered, e.g. a PR or a deployed preview).

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task (admin, project manager or project lead). It goes to the deleted list and can be restored with restore_task.

tools.name: restore_task
tools.description: Restore a deleted task. Takes the Mongo id from list_deleted_tasks.

tools.name: list_deleted_tasks
tools.description: List deleted tasks of your projects (id | number | title | deleted at).

tools.name: get_task_history
tools.description: Change history of a task: who changed which field from what to what.

tools.name: list_task_tags
tools.description: List the tags used on tasks, optionally for one project.

tools.name: add_task_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task, optionally with images (each from an https URL or base64). Images are stored in the project files under tasks/<task number>/.

tools.name: update_task_comment
tools.description: Edit the text of one of your own comments; it is marked as edited. Comments of others can only be deleted (by admins, project managers and project leads), not edited.

tools.name: delete_task_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment (your own, or any as admin, project manager or project lead).

tools.name: toggle_task_comment_reaction
tools.description: Add your emoji reaction to a comment, or remove it if you already reacted with that emoji.

tools.name: attach_file_to_task
tools.description: Attach an image or file to a task. Give sourceUrl (https) or base64 + fileName, or fileItemId of a file already in workload.zero. The file is stored in the project files under tasks/<task number>/ like in the app; returns a download link.

tools.name: remove_task_attachment
tools.description: Remove an attachment from a task and move the file to the trash (your own attachment, or any as admin, project manager or project lead).

tools.name: get_my_time_entries
tools.description: Get your time entries (id | date | hours | project | task | description) with the total.

tools.name: list_time_entries
tools.description: List time entries of everyone you may see (admin and project manager view), filterable by project, user and date.

tools.name: log_time
tools.description: Log time on a project, optionally for a task. Example: projectId, taskId, date "2026-11-04", hours 1.5, description "Code review". With startTime/endTime (HH:mm) the entry shows the time span.

tools.name: update_time_entry
tools.description: Change a time entry (hours, date, description, task, start/end time, billable). Give only the fields to change.

tools.name: delete_time_entry
tools.description: Delete one of your time entries. Entries that are already invoiced or approved cannot be deleted.

tools.name: start_timer
tools.description: Start the running timer for a project (and task). Stop it with stop_timer to book the time.

tools.name: stop_timer
tools.description: Stop the running timer and book the time as a time entry.

tools.name: get_active_timer
tools.description: Show the running timer, if any (project, task, start time).

tools.name: discard_timer
tools.description: Discard the running timer without booking any time.

tools.name: get_todays_goals
tools.description: Get your goals for today (id | title | timeframe | task | project | checklist progress).

tools.name: get_week_goals
tools.description: Get your goals for the current week (Monday to Sunday), with checklist progress.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: List goals by date range (YYYY-MM-DD) or timeframe, e.g. startDate 2026-11-01, endDate 2026-11-30.

tools.name: get_goals_for_task
tools.description: Get all goals linked to a task (task Mongo id), e.g. to see when work on it is planned.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a daily or weekly goal, optionally linked to a task or project, with a checklist; shown in workload.zero as created by an agent. Example: title "Ship invoice export", checklist [{"label": "Write tests"}].

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update a goal: date, title, task, project, color, time slot or checklist. Give only the fields to change. The legacy `updates` JSON string is still accepted.

tools.name: complete_goal
tools.description: Mark a goal as completed. Checklist items keep their own state.

tools.name: check_goal_item
tools.description: Tick or untick one checklist item of a goal (index is 0-based, in the order list_goals shows).

tools.name: delete_goal
tools.description: Delete a goal and its checklist. Linked tasks and time entries stay.

tools.name: list_my_absences
tools.description: List your absences (vacation, sick days, comp time) with status.

tools.name: list_absences
tools.description: List the absences you may see as admin or project manager, optionally by date range or status.

tools.name: request_absence
tools.description: Request an absence. Example: type "vacation", startDate "2026-12-22", endDate "2026-12-31". Partial days: startTime/endTime or hours.

tools.name: update_absence
tools.description: Change an absence request (dates, type, reason). Give only the fields to change.

tools.name: delete_absence
tools.description: Withdraw an absence request or delete an absence. The team calendar updates immediately.

tools.name: review_absence
tools.description: Approve or reject an absence request (admin or manager). The employee sees the decision.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List your invoices (id | number | date | gross total | status | buyer).

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Get an invoice with line items, buyer, totals and status. Accepts the id or the invoice number, e.g. RE-2026-0042.

tools.name: create_invoice_from_time
tools.description: Create a draft invoice from the unbilled time entries of a project in a period.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a draft invoice by hand. It stays a draft: finalizing and sending happen in the app, and finalizing needs a real sender address with a tax number or VAT ID (billingEntityId from list_billing_entities, or create_billing_entity with data the user gives you, never invented). Example: invoiceDate

tools.name: update_invoice
tools.description: Update a draft invoice. Give only the fields to change; lineItems replaces the whole list; billingEntityId changes the sender and may renumber the draft. Finalized invoices cannot be changed.

tools.name: delete_invoice
tools.description: Delete a draft invoice. Finalized invoices cannot be deleted.

tools.name: record_invoice_payment
tools.description: Record a (partial) payment on an invoice. Example: amount 1190, paidAt "2026-11-04".

tools.name: list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List the payments recorded on an invoice.

tools.name: get_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Get the PDF of an invoice as an attached file.

tools.name: get_revenue
tools.description: Revenue breakdown of the year (per month, per client).

tools.name: get_unbilled_hours
tools.description: Hours that are tracked but not invoiced yet, per project.

tools.name: list_billing_clients
tools.description: List billing clients (id | company | invoice email | payment terms). Use the id for invoices and quotes.

tools.name: list_billing_entities
tools.description: List your sender entities (id | name | default). Quotes and invoices are issued in the name of one of them.

tools.name: create_billing_entity
tools.description: Create a sender for quotes and invoices. This data is printed on legal documents such as quotes and invoices, so use only what the user gives you and never invent or guess a value. An invoice cannot be finalized without the company name, full address, and a tax number or VAT ID; bank details belong

tools.name: update_billing_entity
tools.description: Update a sender from list_billing_entities. Give only the fields to change. This data is printed on legal documents such as quotes and invoices, so use only what the user gives you and never invent or guess a value. An invoice cannot be finalized without the company name, full address, and a tax num

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description: List your quotes (id | number | date | status | customer).

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get a quote with positions, customer, totals and status.

tools.name: estimate_quote
tools.description: Estimate a quote from a scope description. Returns deterministic 'historical' and 'rate-card' variants (each with sum and confidence) plus the context (comparable past projects, standard rate). Add your own 'free-scope' variant from the context, then present all variants with totals so the user can

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Create a quote as a DRAFT. Needs a real sender: billingEntityId from list_billing_entities, or create_billing_entity first with data the user gives you, never invented. Example: date "2026-11-04", billingClientId from list_billing_clients, positions [{description: "Design workshop", quantity: 2, uni

tools.name: update_quote
tools.description: Update a draft quote. Give only the fields to change; positions replaces the whole list; billingEntityId changes the sender.

tools.name: delete_quote
tools.description: Delete a quote that has not been sent yet. Sent quotes stay for the record.

tools.name: get_quote_pdf
tools.description: Get the PDF of a quote as an attached file.

tools.name: convert_quote_to_invoice
tools.description: Convert an ACCEPTED quote into a draft invoice (positions 1:1).

tools.name: send_quote
tools.description: Send a quote to the client by email. This ONLY works after the user approved the quote for sending in the app. There is intentionally no tool to grant that approval; sending stays under human control.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: List deals (id | title | stage | status | value | ref), optionally by stage, pipeline or company.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Get a deal with contacts, company, products, notes and its activities.

tools.name: create_deal
tools.description: Create a deal. Example: title "Website relaunch Acme", value 24000, stage "proposal", companyId, contactIds.

tools.name: upsert_deal
tools.description: Create or update a deal idempotently by campaign ref (derived from the lead email).

tools.name: update_deal
tools.description: Update a deal by id: stage, status, notes, value, loss reason, tags, title, probability, expected close date, contacts, company.

tools.name: move_deal_stage
tools.description: Move a deal to another pipeline stage, e.g. "negotiation".

tools.name: mark_deal_won
tools.description: Mark a deal as won; status won, stage closed_won, counts in reports.

tools.name: mark_deal_lost
tools.description: Mark a deal as lost with a reason, e.g. "Budget moved to 2027".

tools.name: link_deal_to_project
tools.description: Link a won deal to the workload.zero project that delivers it.

tools.name: delete_deal
tools.description: Delete a deal (it is hidden from lists and reports, its activities stay).

tools.name: convert_deal
tools.description: Convert a deal by ref code (idempotent): stage converted, status won.

tools.name: find_deal_by_ref
tools.description: Find a deal by its 6-hex campaign ref code.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List CRM companies (id | name | industry), optionally by search text.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get a CRM company with its contacts and deals.

tools.name: upsert_company
tools.description: Create or update a CRM company idempotently by name.

tools.name: update_company
tools.description: Update a CRM company by id, e.g. to rename it. Give only the fields to change.

tools.name: delete_company
tools.description: Delete a CRM company (it is hidden, its contacts stay).

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List CRM contacts (id | name | email | company | position), optionally by search text or company.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get a CRM contact with deals and timeline (activities, mails, notes).

tools.name: upsert_contact
tools.description: Create or update a CRM contact idempotently by email.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update a CRM contact by id, e.g. to change the email address. Give only the fields to change.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a CRM contact. Before deleting for GDPR reasons, add the address to the suppression list.

tools.name: list_sales_activities
tools.description: List sales activities (calls, emails, meetings, tasks, notes), optionally for a contact, deal or company, or only upcoming/overdue ones.

tools.name: create_sales_activity
tools.description: Log or schedule a sales activity. Example: type "call", subject "Follow-up on proposal", contactId, dealId, scheduledAt "2026-11-06T10:00:00Z".

tools.name: update_sales_activity
tools.description: Update a sales activity. Give only the fields to change.

tools.name: complete_sales_activity
tools.description: Mark a sales activity (call, email, meeting, task) as done.

tools.name: delete_sales_activity
tools.description: Delete a sales activity from the deal and contact timeline.

tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: List leads (id | name | email | company | status | score).

tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead (a person not yet qualified), e.g. from an event or a website form.

tools.name: update_lead
tools.description: Update a lead, e.g. its status. Give only the fields to change.

tools.name: delete_lead
tools.description: Delete a lead that is not converted.

tools.name: qualify_lead
tools.description: Mark a lead as qualified, ready to convert into a contact and deal.

tools.name: convert_lead
tools.description: Convert a lead into a contact (and company), optionally with a new deal.

tools.name: list_pipelines
tools.description: List sales pipelines (id | name | stages | default).

tools.name: create_pipeline
tools.description: Create a sales pipeline with its stages.

tools.name: update_pipeline
tools.description: Update a sales pipeline: name, stages (replaces the whole list) or default flag.

tools.name: set_default_pipeline
tools.description: Set a sales pipeline as the default for new deals.

tools.name: delete_pipeline
tools.description: Delete a sales pipeline. Move or close its deals first.

tools.name: get_sales_report
tools.description: Sales reports. report: pipeline-value, conversion-rates, activity-metrics, forecast, win-loss, sales-velocity, leaderboard. Default pipeline-value.

tools.name: check_suppression
tools.description: Check whether email addresses are on the suppression list (do-not-contact). ALWAYS call this before sending any outreach email; never email an address reported as suppressed.

tools.name: add_suppression
tools.description: Add an email address or a whole domain to the suppression list, e.g. after an unsubscribe, an objection (GDPR Art. 21), an erasure request (Art. 17) or an access request (Art. 15).

tools.name: list_suppressions
tools.description: List suppression list entries, optionally filtered by search, reason or open GDPR requests.

tools.name: mark_gdpr_answered
tools.description: Mark the GDPR request (Art. 15/17/21) of a suppression list entry as answered.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List your chats (id | title | participants | unread | last message).

tools.name: get_chat_messages
tools.description: Read the latest messages of a chat, oldest first (message id | time | sender | text). Use before (ISO time of the oldest shown message) to page back.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message in a chat. The participants see it immediately.

tools.name: send_direct_message
tools.description: Send a direct message to a person (user id from list_users). Opens the direct chat if there is none yet.

tools.name: create_chat
tools.description: Create a group chat with people (user ids from list_users), optionally tied to projects.

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Edit one of your chat messages. Participants see the new text marked as edited.

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete one of your chat messages for all participants.

tools.name: mark_chat_read
tools.description: Mark all messages of a chat as read; resets its unread count.

tools.name: get_unread_counts
tools.description: Unread message counts per chat id, for a quick inbox check.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and folders in a space or in one folder of it (id | name | file/folder | size | updated).

tools.name: list_recent_files
tools.description: List the files you opened or changed recently, across all spaces.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search files by name across your spaces.

tools.name: get_file_details
tools.description: Get details of a file or folder: name, type, size, owner, versions, tags.

tools.name: get_file_link
tools.description: Get a temporary download link for a file (open it to view or download; the link expires, call again for a fresh one).

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file into a space (optionally into a folder) from an https URL or base64. Allowed: images (png, jpeg, gif, webp, heic), pdf, txt, md, csv, json, zip, docx, xlsx, pptx. Returns the file id and a download link. To attach a file to a task use attach_file_to_task.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in a space, optionally inside another folder.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Move a file or folder to the trash (it can be restored in the app).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_suppression" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
